_comment: Licences of packages that declare none of their own, keyed name@version so an update is checked again. Each entry names where the licence was read. `texts` adds a licence text (a file of texts/) to a package that carries the work of a project without that project's text, keyed by name. Input to scripts/licenses.sh (RD-130-12, RD-1480-12); third-party.json and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt are generated, this file is not.

@iconify-json/lucide.label: LICENSE of the Lucide project
@iconify-json/lucide.source: LICENSE of the npm package @lucide/vue 1.66.0, which the Lucide project publishes; @iconify-json/lucide names https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/LICENSE as its licence and carries no text
